svg.text: Editable source pairs from the primary QuotaCo building-system bank.

svg.title: QuotaCo Building System full exterior corner base
svg.desc: The lower green fascia and compact plinth turn through one molded northwest L, preserving the flat north face and shaded west stack without a post or applied corner plate.

svg.title: QuotaCo Building System full exterior corner upper
svg.desc: One molded QuotaCo northwest outer corner: the flat north face and broad west plane share a contained return while their coral, green, and plinth registers turn without a patch arc or applied corner box.

svg.title: QuotaCo Building System full north straight base
svg.desc: Broad lower green fascia, compact floor-contact plinth, and a quiet boundary service seam for the flat front-on north wall; the composed upper owns the reveal and thin coral register.

svg.title: QuotaCo Building System full north straight upper
svg.desc: Flat front-on treatment: a 5-unit lit coping reveal, broad cream face, thin coral register, and uninterrupted green fascia meeting the lower component without a second cap or ledge.

svg.title: QuotaCo Building System full terminus base
svg.desc: The accepted horizontal straight base profile flows unchanged into a compact molded terminus; the composed upper owns the exposed top and end planes.

svg.title: QuotaCo Building System full terminus upper
svg.desc: The accepted horizontal straight upper profile flows unchanged into a monolithic banded post, with local end-plane shading confined to the molded cap.

svg.title: QuotaCo Building System full west straight base
svg.desc: Lower green face under the descending-face shade, compact floor-contact plinth, and a quiet boundary service seam for the flatter-from-above west wall.

svg.title: QuotaCo Building System full west straight upper
svg.desc: Flatter-from-above treatment: a broad lit top plane behind the shared coping lip, then a compressed shaded east stack with a thin coral register and broader green handoff.

svg.title: QuotaCo Building System full-height southwest corner base
svg.desc: One molded equal-height southwest base preserving the full west north socket and the shared full north/south east socket.

svg.title: QuotaCo Building System full-height southwest corner upper
svg.desc: One molded equal-height southwest upper: west planes terminate behind a full-height south frontage whose cream, coral, green, and plinth stack owns the foreground heel.

svg.text: Accepted proof-bank pairs referenced by the production 47-frame ledger.

svg.title: QuotaCo double-filled northeast-southwest cross-junction review base
svg.desc: One flattened S-shaped lower structure fills northeast and southwest while only the open southeast return owns visible frontage material.

svg.title: QuotaCo double-filled northeast-southwest cross-junction review upper
svg.desc: One authored cream S-union fills northeast and southwest, leaves northwest and southeast open, and carries four sockets without a center peak or doubled belt.

svg.title: QuotaCo double-filled east cross-junction accepted proof base
svg.desc: One accepted flattened lower structure buries the full east slab and exposes only the southwest frontage of the west branch.

svg.title: QuotaCo double-filled east cross-junction accepted proof upper
svg.desc: One accepted fixed-light cream shell joins the solid east slab to a west branch through two open crooks with a northwest reveal and arris seam aligned to the outer ledge, with no buried fascia or center post.

svg.title: QuotaCo double-filled north cross-junction review base
svg.desc: One flattened lower structure buries the north slab, preserves both open southern crooks, and exposes no duplicate north fascia.

svg.title: QuotaCo double-filled north cross-junction accepted upper
svg.desc: One fixed-view cream owner makes the filled north slab continuous through the south socket, leaves both southern crooks open, and keeps frontage shading off the top-to-top join.

svg.title: QuotaCo double-filled south cross-junction accepted base
svg.desc: One flattened lower structure buries the south slab and carries only the fixed-view side register of the north spur, with no horizontal coral or green frontage inside the solid mass.

svg.title: QuotaCo double-filled south cross-junction accepted upper
svg.desc: One fixed-view cream owner joins a north spur to a continuous south slab while both northern crooks stay open and no buried horizontal material fascia survives.

svg.title: QuotaCo fully filled center review base
svg.desc: A completely buried structural underlay for the center of a solid wall mass.

svg.title: QuotaCo fully filled center review upper
svg.desc: A full-cell cream field for a completely buried center.

svg.title: QuotaCo open-north T-junction proof base
svg.desc: The east-west base folds into one outgoing south socket, suppressing the buried center plinth while preserving the horizontal frontage and fixed-light service ownership.

svg.title: QuotaCo open-north T-junction proof upper
svg.desc: The separately authored rear T carries one uninterrupted cream shell through the outgoing south branch while one synchronized coral, green, shade, and seam stack turns around the exposed frontage.

svg.title: QuotaCo open-south T-junction proof base
svg.desc: The incoming north base folds behind one continuous east-west foreground frontage, preserving exact north, east, and west sockets without a cap or center post.

svg.title: QuotaCo open-south T-junction proof upper
svg.desc: The separately authored foreground T keeps one uninterrupted horizontal cream, coral, and green frontage while the north branch shares one synchronized molded turn into its east-facing wall plane.

svg.title: QuotaCo accepted open-north T-junction with filled southeast pocket base
svg.desc: The southeast quadrant is a plain buried underlay while the southwest crook retains only the accepted horizontal frontage needed by the west socket.

svg.title: QuotaCo accepted open-north T-junction with filled southeast pocket upper
svg.desc: One molded rear source keeps the southwest crook open while the southeast quadrant becomes a quiet cream wall top with one shared reveal exposure across the turn.

svg.title: QuotaCo accepted open-south T-junction with filled northeast pocket base
svg.desc: The northeast quadrant is a buried structural underlay while the west socket retains the accepted horizontal green frontage and compact plinth.

svg.title: QuotaCo accepted open-south T-junction with filled northeast pocket upper
svg.desc: One molded foreground source keeps the northwest crook open while the northeast quadrant becomes a continuous cream wall top flowing into the filled east socket.

svg.title: QuotaCo equal-height isolated structural shell base proposal
svg.desc: Proof-only zero-socket wall cell. One squat molded green housing occupies the accepted wall-envelope intersection and closes against a continuous charcoal floor-contact edge.

svg.title: QuotaCo equal-height isolated structural shell upper proposal
svg.desc: Proof-only zero-socket wall cell. One front-on high-oblique construction: a continuous cream coping plane sits above a single horizontal coral and green wall stack without caps, collars, panels, or cardinal seams.

svg.title: QuotaCo open-pocket cross-junction proposal base
svg.desc: One flattened lower frontage joins all four accepted sockets without a stacked T overlay, center post, or buried inner cap.

svg.title: QuotaCo open-pocket cross-junction proposal upper
svg.desc: One authored fixed-view four-way shell preserves four concave floor pockets and lets the horizontal frontage carry the north and south branches through one molded hub.

svg.title: QuotaCo open-west T-junction accepted proof base
svg.desc: The lower green frontage and compact plinth continue through one vertical spine while the east-branch contact shade stops at the south socket return.

svg.title: QuotaCo open-west T-junction accepted proof upper
svg.desc: One continuous cream T hub with a longitudinal west-wall spine and a molded east branch; fixed-light registers meet without a cap or center post.

svg.title: QuotaCo single-filled northeast cross-junction accepted base
svg.desc: One flattened lower structure joins four accepted sockets, buries the northeast diagonal, and preserves the three remaining open crooks without stacked source art.

svg.title: QuotaCo single-filled northeast cross-junction accepted upper
svg.desc: One fixed-light cream union fills the northeast diagonal, keeps the other three floor crooks open, and carries four exact sockets through a peak-free authored hub.

svg.title: QuotaCo single-filled northwest cross-junction accepted base
svg.desc: One flattened lower structure joins four accepted sockets, buries the northwest diagonal, and preserves the three remaining open crooks without transformed or stacked source art.

svg.title: QuotaCo single-filled northwest cross-junction accepted upper
svg.desc: One directly authored east-register cream union fills the northwest diagonal, keeps the other three floor crooks open, and carries four exact sockets through a peak-free hub.

svg.title: QuotaCo single-filled southeast cross-junction accepted proof base
svg.desc: One accepted flattened lower structure joins four sockets, buries the southeast diagonal, and preserves the three remaining open crooks without stacked source art.

svg.title: QuotaCo single-filled southeast cross-junction accepted proof upper
svg.desc: One accepted fixed-light cream union fills the southeast diagonal, keeps the other three floor crooks open, and carries four exact sockets through a peak-free authored hub.

svg.title: QuotaCo single-open northwest cross-junction review base
svg.desc: One flattened lower union fills northeast, southeast, and southwest while the northwest crook remains open floor.

svg.title: QuotaCo single-open northwest cross-junction review upper
svg.desc: One fixed-view cream owner forms the three-solid four-way union while the northwest crook remains open and no buried frontage belt is repainted.

svg.title: QuotaCo single-open southwest cross-junction accepted base
svg.desc: One flattened lower union fills northeast, southeast, and northwest while the southwest return alone exposes the fixed-view material depth.

svg.title: QuotaCo single-open southwest cross-junction accepted upper
svg.desc: One fixed-view cream owner forms the three-solid four-way union while only the southwest floor crook carries an exposed coral and green return.

svg.title: QuotaCo Building System full exterior corner base
svg.desc: The lower green fascia and compact plinth turn through one molded northwest L, preserving the flat north face and shaded west stack without a post or applied corner plate.

svg.title: QuotaCo filled northwest elbow accepted proof upper
svg.desc: The accepted northwest exterior is recut as one solid cream quadrant with no surviving southeast pocket face.

svg.title: QuotaCo Building System full-height southwest corner base
svg.desc: One molded equal-height southwest base preserving the full west north socket and the shared full north/south east socket.

svg.title: QuotaCo filled southwest elbow accepted proof upper
svg.desc: The accepted southwest foreground frontage wraps one solid cream quadrant with a cream lip and dark separation line above the coral and green return.

svg.title: QuotaCo filled north middle accepted proof base
svg.desc: A fully buried structural underlay beneath the rear middle cell of a two-row solid wall mass.

svg.title: QuotaCo filled north middle accepted proof upper
svg.desc: A cream-only rear span with exact east and west sockets and no buried foreground fascia.

svg.title: QuotaCo Building System full north straight base
svg.desc: Broad lower green fascia, compact floor-contact plinth, and a quiet boundary service seam for the flat front-on north wall; the composed upper owns the reveal and thin coral register.

svg.title: QuotaCo filled south middle accepted proof upper
svg.desc: The foreground middle span continues the cream plane, south material shade, cream lip, dark separation line, coral register, green frontage, and plinth without a doubled boundary.

svg.title: QuotaCo filled west middle proof base
svg.desc: A fully buried structural underlay for the repeatable west side of a two-cell-thick wall mass.

svg.title: QuotaCo filled west middle proof upper
svg.desc: A plain cream spine with exact north and south sockets and one west outline.

svg.title: QuotaCo equal-height west wall — exposed north end base proposal
svg.desc: Proof-only rear wall closure base. The ordinary green side field stays longitudinal into the rounded north edge, then resumes the accepted south socket without a separate post or casing.

svg.title: QuotaCo equal-height west wall — exposed north end upper proposal
svg.desc: Proof-only rear wall closure. The broad cream plane and the narrow coral and green registers remain longitudinal while the shared wall envelope rounds into one quiet north edge.

svg.title: QuotaCo equal-height west wall — exposed south end base proposal
svg.desc: Proof-only foreground wall closure base. The ordinary west-wall green face folds beneath the south rollover and closes against the existing charcoal contact edge.

svg.title: QuotaCo equal-height west wall — exposed south end upper proposal
svg.desc: Proof-only foreground wall closure. The ordinary cream, coral, and green wall registers turn continuously through one shallow south rollover without a wider cap or attached housing.

svg.title: QuotaCo open-west T-junction with filled northeast pocket proof base
svg.desc: The northeast half is a buried structural underlay while the southeast crook retains the accepted green frontage and clips its contact shade around the continuing south socket.

svg.title: QuotaCo open-west T-junction with filled northeast pocket proof upper
svg.desc: A solid cream northeast wall-top flows into the east socket while the southeast branch face keeps a cream lip and dark separation line above its coral and green return.

svg.title: QuotaCo open-west T-junction with filled southeast pocket proof base
svg.desc: The northeast crook retains the accepted shaded vertical frontage while the southeast half becomes a plain buried structural underlay.

svg.title: QuotaCo open-west T-junction with filled southeast pocket proof upper
svg.desc: The exposed northeast return rolls into a continuous solid cream southeast wall-top without leaving a buried horizontal fascia or cap.
